body.value: Thanne longen folk to goon on pilgrimages, / And palmeres for to seken straunge strondes, / To ferne halwes, kowthe in sondry londes; / And specially from every shires ende / Of Engelond to Caunterbury they wende, / The hooly blisful martir for to seke, / That hem hath holpen whan that they were seeke. (Then people long to go on pilgrimages / And palmers to seek strange shores / To distant shrines, known in various lands; / And especially from every shire's end / Of England to Canterbury they go / The holy blissful martyr to seek / Who has helped them when they were sick.)
